reviewer.role: Independent technical worker with historical context; not a cold aesthetic or human review

scope.output: Only this new technical report; no native promotion or aesthetic verdict

inputs.format: PNG headers and decoded pixels inspected; target RGB 1536x1024
inputs.copy_seen: 茶作 / 一杯茶，慢下来

composite.method: Independently rendered registered brand/body SVG with pinned Sharp/rsvg, then Pillow source-over onto S; RGBA/alpha hashes match

renderer.boundary: Registered composition is exact. Native Figma PNG uses a different renderer; no native-render losslessness claim

live_figma.controls: Exactly one image fill, source locked, filters zero, identity fill transform; captured nodes visible/opacity1/no effects/strokes/masks; hierarchy/order/fills checked; no hidden duplicate photo found

actual_binding.boundary: Float32 anchor/coordinate and official SVG precision tolerances; native paths not byte-identical. Earlier module was changing; latest normal call was byte-stable. Full negative controls/fresh challenge not certified

lettering.method: One built-in RGBA generation; alpha>=128; unmodified VTracer0.6.15. All17 nonempty d/translate strings match actual upstream trace; one uniform matrix; no mask
lettering.deps: Archived VTracer wheel/install wrapper and binary matched; complete MIT license read; pinned existing Pillow/Sharp/FontTools, no installation
lettering.limits: Threshold is not original-alpha lossless; backend/font mechanism not exposed; no exclusive authorship claim

drive.metadata: Correct PNG/SVG MIME/size, recorded same project folder, shared=false

runtime.actual_warm_maker: 6 actual Sol/Max contexts, three V22 ImageView entries; captured prefix SHA matched
runtime.dynamic_load_boundary: Outer call hashes alone do not certify loaded content; actual files/replay/native capture checked separately

metadata_correction.observed: Preserved before-files contain inherited V21 clip/imagegen0/retained-outline claims. Corrected V22 declares no mask, one new type generation/new17 trace; actual checks corroborate. No aesthetic inference

closure.old_five_key_failure: Preserved; authority approval alone does not repair implementation

limitations: Technical result is not aesthetic or human acceptance; extent of product occlusion belongs to the separate pixel review.
New guard full regression/negative controls and fresh challenge require separate closure.
Local generated PNG verified; its additional Drive archive was not independently fetched here.
Current binding depends on pinned dependencies and authorized original host rollout paths; fresh-clone/off-host restoration not demonstrated.
Normal read-only plus one bad-source control do not certify all races, optimized Python, multi-file atomicity or OS-level isolation.
